test_mpc_arithmetic_ops: test MPCTensor arithmetic operations including add, sub, mul, div on encrypted tensors
test_mpc_conv_pooling: test encrypted tensor convolution and pooling operations like conv1d, conv2d, max_pool2d, avg_pool2d
test_mpc_comparison_reduction: test encrypted tensor comparators, max, min, argmax, argmin with multiple reduction algorithms
test_mpc_approximations: test approximate functions on encrypted tensors including exp, log, sqrt, sigmoid, tanh, softmax
test_mpc_tensor_manipulation: test encrypted tensor manipulation operations including view, flatten, transpose, squeeze, unsqueeze, pad
